snippet.title: Scale the Depths - Play as a cute robot hoping to feed any hungry customers that swim your way!
snippet.description:
Play for free on itch.io https://serpexnessie.itch.io/scale-the-depths?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Scale Depth features an addictive fishing and scaling gameplay loop where you play as a cute robot hoping to feed any hungry customers that swim your way. Use a variety of hooks, knives, and rods to achieve your goal.
